name: Lubawa S.A.
summary: Lubawa S.A., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells army, police, municipal police, border patrol, fire brigade, and special force products in Poland and internationally. The company operates through the Fabrics and Knitwear, Advertising Articles, Specialist Equipment, and Others segments.
